title: Glucose Plugin Reading doesn't match with graph (Phone)
body:
On the phone:
xDrip - Menu - Less Common Settings - Advanced Calibration
Calibration Plugin: Datricsae
Use Plugin Glucose : ON

**Low set for 70mg/dL. No red dot.**
![83907087_10220852641216117_3493628648852815872_o](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/608650/73923460-d0abd980-48c2-11ea-93c4-f4bccfe3dbd7.jpg)

**Reading 147, Graph Dot = 151.6**
![84511137_10220856821160613_9070479498993991680_o](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/608650/73923574-fafd9700-48c2-11ea-9518-452db2f7d531.jpg)

comments.body: @jamorham Can you take a look on this?

Isn't the plugin a calibration plug-in?
I'm just wondering if I labeled it correctly.  Please let me know if not.
Thanks

@parapenT1sta Can you explain what the problem is?
Can you explain what you expect first?  And then explain what happens that is unexpected?

@Navid200 When using Calibration Plugin **Datricsae** with MiaoMiao/Bubble + Libre, the last reading (numeric value) doesn't match with the value drawn in the graphic.

1st image: **low** value set on graph is below 70, but the last reading drawn is over 70 (blue dot) but the Datricsae (Reading) value is 66 (red).
2nd image: Datricsae (reading) value is 147 but if I press on the latest dot drawn on the graph, the value is 151.6 (check the bottom of the image), 147 numeric vs 151.6 graph.

This also happening with WearOS but I Can't confirm it right now since I don't own WearOS watch at the moment.
